summary: community.vmware removed several deprecated module_utils helpers (PyVmomiDeviceHelper nvdimm methods, PyVmomi find_vmdk_file, host_version_at_least, network_exists_by_name, vmdk_disk_path_split, connect_to_api, find_host_portgroup_by_name, VmwareRestClient.get_folder_by_name), the plugin_utils.inventory util and plugins.httpapi.
questions: My custom module imports connect_to_api from community.vmware and now fails, why?
Which community.vmware helper functions were dropped in Ansible 15?

answer_card.title: community.vmware: removed module_utils helpers
answer_card.answer_md:
Removed from community.vmware (affects custom modules/plugins importing them):

- `vm_device_helper.PyVmomiDeviceHelper.is_nvdimm_controller` / `is_nvdimm_device`
- `vmware.PyVmomi.find_vmdk_file`, `host_version_at_least`, `network_exists_by_name`, `vmdk_disk_path_split`, `find_host_portgroup_by_name`
- `vmware.connect_to_api` and `find_host_portgroup_by_name` function
- `vmware_rest_client.VmwareRestClient.get_folder_by_name`
- `plugin_utils.inventory` and `plugins.httpapi`

Copy the logic into your own code or move to `vmware.vmware` utilities.
